text: Agile methodology is a modern way of managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at once, teams work in short cycles called sprints, which usually last two to four weeks. Before each sprint, the team chooses tasks from a backlog, a prioritized list of features often written as user stories. Every day, team members hold quick standups to share progress and discuss problems. This iterative development approach allows teams to deliver small, working parts of the product regularly and adapt to changes based on feedback. Agile helps teams stay flexible, improve communication, and respond faster to customer needs.
